title: Sus Chords in A Dorian
summary: Turn dominant and minor 7 chords into 7sus4 chords, and use them together over a minor vamp.

helpful.why: Every chord here is a Drop 2 voicing: a closed chord with its second note from the top dropped an octave.
The lesson stays inside one mode over a minor 7 to dominant 7 vamp.
A 7sus4 swaps the 3rd of a dominant 7 for the 4th.
